preconditions.description: The length of the ciphered text n is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(t) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The ciphered text t has length n and consists only of lowercase English letters.
The number of words m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(w) <= 1000 and all(c.isalpha() for c in w) for w in words)
preconditions.description: Each word in the list is non-empty, has length at most 1000, and consists only of English letters.
The total length of all words does not exceed 1,000,000.
It is guaranteed that at least one valid original sentence exists.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-empty string representing the original sentence, with no leading or trailing whitespace.

postconditions.expression: all(w in words for w in output_sentence.split())
postconditions.description: Every word in the output sentence (split by spaces) exists exactly as given in the input word list.
Applying the cipher rules (lowercase, reverse each word, remove spaces) to the output sentence yields the input ciphered text exactly.
